//: Documents every configuration key the API reads. Copy the values into User Secrets (dotnet user-secrets) or environment variables; never commit real values.

Auth.//: Development signs and validates with this symmetric key; it belongs in User Secrets, never in a committed file. At least 32 characters, because HS256 needs 256 bits.
Auth.//Authority: Set Authority (and Audience) instead of SigningKey to validate tokens from Microsoft Entra ID. The handler then fetches the issuer's keys itself and no code changes.

Directory.//: Which implementation of ICustomerDirectory is registered. Soap calls the public demo service; InMemory keeps the demo working when that service cannot be reached.
